title: 第457章 丹王千金结交第456章 长生门要复仇
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机

第457章丹王千金结交
陈阳不敢怠慢，立刻盘膝端坐，凝神静气，全身心运转功法，耐心消化肆虐的药力，将散乱的灵力逐一梳理、炼化。
过了好一阵子，他终于将四颗丹药药力彻底消化，尽数转化为精纯真气，稳稳汇入丹田之中。
感受着体内充盈暴涨的力量，陈阳眼底满是激动，低声自语：“再来！”
他随即又倒出三颗丹药，一口吞入腹中，剩下的一颗收回纳戒，再度盘膝而坐，沉下心神继续消化丹力。
很快，第二波药力也被他彻底吸收干净。
这一刻，他丹田之内的力量骤然暴涨，气息节节攀升。
陈阳内视自身，一下清晰看到丹田内光状的真气进度，已然从二级武神前期，突破到中期层次。
不止修为精进，他的肉身筋骨、经脉强度也在丹药的滋养下强化不少。
浑身力量充盈，状态极佳。
真切感受到自身的巨大提升，陈阳心中满是欣喜激动。
就在这时，门外传来一阵轻盈细碎的脚步声，紧接着，房门被人轻轻叩响，一道温柔礼貌的女声从门外传来，语气亲切恭敬：“陈少，请问您在吗？”
陈阳双目一亮，立刻催动透视能力看向门外。
门外站着一名身形纤细的女子，正是昨日跟在丹王之子聂天身边的女助手梦遥。
她今日换了一身干净素雅的通勤套装，长发束成利落的高马尾，五官清秀干练，气质沉稳温婉，举止得体。
周身没有携带任何灵力气息，看起来并无恶意，而且四周空空荡荡，没有其他人埋伏。
陈阳心中微微意外，收敛气息，起身快步上前，伸手打开了房门。
梦遥见房门打开，直视陈阳的瞬间，眼底下意识闪过一丝紧张，身体微微紧绷，但很快就稳住心神，姿态恭敬地开口：“陈少，冒昧打扰您了。
我家小姐想要认识一下您，她就在酒店的客房等候，不知您能否移步过去一趟？”
陈阳心中有些好奇，看对方态度客气诚恳，也不好直接拒绝，同时也想弄清楚对方小姐找自己的目的，就开口问：“你家小姐叫什么？”

梦遥立刻应声回答：“我家小姐名叫聂小灵。”
陈阳微微点头，干脆应下：“行，你前面带路。”
梦遥闻言，脸上瞬间露出一抹喜色，连忙侧身做出引路的手势：“陈少这边请。”
她说完立刻迈步在前头带路。
陈阳随手关好房门，步履从容地跟在她身后。
梦遥带着陈阳穿梭在酒店走廊，一路步伐轻盈，很快抵达一间高档豪华客房门前。
她抬手轻轻推开房门，侧身做出邀请手势，恭敬地将陈阳请入屋内。
房间装修精致奢华，采光通透，落地窗帘半拢。
暖柔的自然光铺满全屋，空气里萦绕着淡淡的清雅馨香，氛围安静又雅致。

Chapter 457: Friendship with the Dan King’s Daughter
Chen Yang did not dare to neglect, and immediately sat cross-legged, concentrating and calming down, running the technique with all his heart, patiently digesting the raging medicinal power, and sorting out and refining the scattered spiritual power one by one.
After a while, he finally completely digested the power of the four pills and transformed them into pure Qi, which was steadily integrated into his Dantian.
Feeling the surge of power filling his body, Chen Yang's eyes were full of excitement and he whispered to himself: "Come again!"
He then poured out three more pills and swallowed them in one gulp. He took the remaining one back and sat cross-legged again, calming down and continuing to digest the power of the pill.
Soon, the second wave of medicinal power was completely absorbed by him.
At this moment, the power in his dantian suddenly surged, and his aura was rising steadily.
Chen Yang looked inside himself and clearly saw the progress of the light-like true energy in his Dantian, which had already broken through from the early stage of the second level Martial God to the middle stage.
Not only has his cultivation improved, but the strength of his physical muscles, bones, and meridians have also been strengthened a lot with the nourishment of the elixir.
The whole body is full of strength and in excellent condition.
Really feeling his huge improvement, Chen Yang was filled with joy and excitement.
At this moment, there was a sound of light and delicate footsteps outside the door. Then, there was a gentle knock on the door, and a gentle and polite female voice came from outside the door. Her tone was kind and respectful: "Mr. Chen, are you there?"
Chen Yang's eyes lit up and he immediately activated his clairvoyance ability to look out the door.
Standing outside the door was a slender woman who was the female assistant Mengyao who was with Nie Tian, ​​the son of King Dan, yesterday.
Today she changed into a clean and elegant commuting suit, her long hair was tied into a neat high ponytail, her facial features were delicate and capable, her temperament was calm and gentle, and she behaved well.
He didn't carry any spiritual energy around him, and he didn't look malicious. The surroundings were empty and no one was ambushing him.
Chen Yang was slightly surprised, he restrained his breath, stood up, walked forward quickly, reached out and opened the door.
When Mengyao saw the door open and looked directly at Chen Yang, a trace of nervousness flashed subconsciously in her eyes, and her body tensed slightly, but she quickly calmed down and spoke respectfully: "Young Master Chen, I take the liberty of disturbing you.
My lady wants to get to know you. She is waiting in the hotel room. Could you please come over? "
Chen Yang was a little curious. Seeing that the other party was polite and sincere, he couldn't refuse directly. At the same time, he also wanted to find out the purpose of the other lady looking for him, so he asked: "What is your lady's name?"
Mengyao immediately responded: "My young lady's name is Nie Xiaoling."
Chen Yang nodded slightly and simply agreed: "Okay, you lead the way."
Hearing this, Mengyao's face instantly showed a hint of joy, and he quickly turned sideways and made a gesture to lead the way: "Master Chen, please come this way."
After she finished speaking, she immediately stepped forward to lead the way.
Chen Yang closed the door and followed her calmly.
Mengyao led Chen Yang through the hotel corridor, walking lightly along the way, and soon arrived at the door of a high-end luxury room.
She raised her hand and gently pushed open the door, turned sideways to make an invitation gesture, and respectfully invited Chen Yang into the room.
The room is exquisitely and luxuriously decorated, with bright lighting and half-closed floor-to-ceiling curtains.
Warm and soft natural light fills the whole house, and a light and elegant fragrance lingers in the air, creating a quiet and elegant atmosphere.
